dct_description_sm: We collect information about physical and chemical parameters of water masses, as well as the composition of the benthic communities occurring in Greenland waters to assess the climate change effects on the benthic-pelagic coupling and on the composition of benthic habitats and communities.  This dataset is produced within the framework of the program Nuuk Basic (www.nuuk-basic.dk), which is coordinated with another monitoring program, Zackenberg Basic, located in Northeast Greenland. These two programs are extensive cross-disciplinary ecological studies that examine the effect of climate change and variability on terrestrial and marine ecosystems.
dct_title_s: Physico-chemical parameters, biomass and species composition of benthic communities in west Greenland
